judgment_calls.decision: All three probable rules require (no rash), (no scabies), (no lice), (no insect bite), since the page says to confirm these before entering its flowchart.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Leave the exclusions only as check_for items and not in the rules; then a patient with a rash could get these diagnoses.

judgment_calls.decision: Jaundice likely is reached only on the No/No branch (not very dry skin, no new medication), as drawn.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Diagnose jaundice from yellow skin/eyes regardless of branch.

judgment_calls.decision: 'In the weeks before the itch started' not modelled; any recorded new medication counts, so the rule may fire more often than the page intends.
judgment_calls.alternatives: A time_ago comparison on the medication onset (e.g. within 6 weeks) would invent a number.
